description: Meept regression gate. One task per fixed bug (see tags for origin commits/gaps). Green twice consecutively = stable.

tasks.prompt: Create a file named routing-check.txt in the repository root containing the text: dispatch works. Use file_write with direct:true.
Create a file named hint-check.txt in the repository root containing the text: hint ok. Use file_write with direct:true.
Create a file named direct-check.txt in the repository root containing: written directly. Use file_write with direct:true.

I want you to remember an important fact in your long-term memory so it survives across conversations: the deployment codeword is BENCH-7391. Store this fact in your memory now. Then confirm the memory was stored by creating a file named mem-store.txt in the repository root containing exactly the word: stored. Use file_write with direct:true.
Create a file named cwd.txt in the repository root containing the absolute path of your current working directory (one line, just the path). Use file_write with direct:true.
Create a file named probe-check.txt in the repository root containing the text: probed. Use file_write with direct:true.

command: python3 -c "import json,glob,os,sys; ms=glob.glob('/Users/caimlas/git/meept-bench/results/**/transcripts/*bus-trace-arrives*.json', recursive=True); t=json.load(open(max(ms, key=os.path.getmtime))); sys.exit(0 if len(t.get('tool_trace', []))>0 else 1)" || (echo 'tool_trace empty or transcript missing - bus subscription regressed (a20b105c)'; exit 1)

tasks.prompt: Create a file named cost-check.txt in the repository root containing the text: costed. Use file_write with direct:true.

command: [ -f /Users/caimlas/git/meept-bench/results/regression/results.jsonl ] || exit 0; python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/Users/caimlas/git/meept-bench/results/regression/results.jsonl') if l.strip()]; bad=[r for r in rows if r.get('verdict')=='pass' and r.get('tokens_in',0)<0]; sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"

tasks.prompt: Create a file named transcript-check.txt in the repository root containing the text: complete. Use file_write with direct:true.

command: python3 -c "import json,glob,os,sys; ms=glob.glob('/Users/caimlas/git/meept-bench/results/**/transcripts/*transcript-completeness*.json', recursive=True); t=json.load(open(max(ms, key=os.path.getmtime))); sys.exit(0 if t.get('final_reply') and t.get('prompt') else 1)"

tasks.prompt: What is the deployment codeword I asked you to remember earlier? It starts with BENCH-. Search your memory for it, then write just the codeword to a file named mem-recall.txt in the repository root. If you cannot find the codeword in memory, write exactly MEMORY-UNAVAILABLE to that file instead. You must write the file either way. Use file_write with direct:true.
tags: xfail: meept cross-conversation recall gap — daemon memory is global but the dispatcher only auto-injects memories with relevance_score > 0.3 and the FTS scores this marker fact at ~0.2, so fresh-conversation recall silently drops it; checker accepts codeword or explicit MEMORY-UNAVAILABLE admission
